remarks: Welcome to this beautifully renovated and charming cottage, a perfect rental nestled in the heart of town! Modern kitchen with newer cabinets, sleek appliances, hardwood flooring, and stunning quartz countertops. You'll love the spacious living room with custom built-ins and large sliding glass doors that fill the space with natural light all day long. Three generously sized bedrooms featuring ample closet space, two fully renovated baths, and hardwood floors throughout, this home offers both comfort and style.  Outside, you'll find a private oasis a level, fenced-in backyard that's ideal for entertaining, complete with a deck perfect for gatherings or quiet evenings outdoors. The attached garage adds convenience on rainy days. Don't miss this opportunity to live in a sweet, beautifully updated home in a prime location!
